candidate_spec.high_level_variant: Same intersection and start pose with ego almost stationary near a signalized junction; slight mission destination shift while preserving minimal motion so that a red-light violation is still triggered without confirmed stop-line or lane-boundary context.
candidate_spec.mutation_intent: Preserves the pattern of an oracle red-light violation in a largely static scene with traffic-light data and minimal ego displacement, while slightly perturbing mission geometry to test robustness of the oracle-level violation under near-identical kinematics and no dynamic actors.
pre_execution_validation_rules: Ensure no additional dynamic actors (vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists) are spawned beyond static traffic-light objects.
Verify that the ego spawn pose remains aligned with the same lane and junction region as the seed scenario (orientation within a few degrees of original yaw).
Confirm that traffic-light objects relevant to the junction are present in the map and that their state topic is being published before ego motion begins.
post_execution_validation_rules: Check oracle output: red=true, crash=false, stuck=false, lane_invasion=false, with no additional failure flags set.
Confirm ego odometry shows very small net displacement between first and last samples (e.g., within a few meters), consistent with “almost stationary” behavior.
Verify traffic-light state messages exist throughout the run, but logs do not provide explicit association between the ego route and any particular stop line or governing signal.
Ensure there is no clearly logged lane-boundary crossing event or explicit planner reference to lane invasion; if present, treat as deviation from this case pattern.
uncertainty: Mechanism by which the oracle triggers red=true (whether due to internal stop-line mapping, timing, or perception) remains unknown and should not be overconstrained.
Dataset-level lane_invasion labels from analogous cases may conflict with online oracle; do not enforce lane invasion here even if offline labels suggest it.
